initEvent should unset returnValue..reason: Requires Document.createEvent; the package exposes no Document provider.

Event.type should initially be the empty.reason: Requires Document.createEvent and its uninitialized-event construction semantics.

Event.type should be initialized by init.reason: Requires Document.createEvent; do not replace the upstream construction with new Event.

wheel listeners on Performance are not p.reason: Requires the package Performance EventTarget, which is item B7 and is not implemented at this base revision.

removing a null event listener should su.reason: Calls globalThis.removeEventListener; the provider bootstrap does not expose a global EventTarget in the ordinary-node environment.

subsetReview.method: Inspected all top-level candidate callbacks with acorn and reviewed callback/helper/top-level DOM dependencies. Also scanned nested events directories; only generic-events-stay-cancelable.html supplies additional standalone coverage.
specificDependencies: Event-constants.html performs document.createEvent in setup before helper-driven registrations.
Event-defaultPrevented.html shares ev from the first document.createEvent case.
Event-type-empty.html calls a helper that creates a Document element even for its Constructor case.
Event-subclasses-constructors.html reads window and document while constructing top-level expected data.
Event-dispatch-redispatch.html has a trivial test nested in browser-driven input work; it is not independent core Event coverage.
